title: The Information Content of Annual Earnings Announcements
one_line: Classic study (143 firms) asking whether trading volume and return volatility rise in the week of annual earnings announcements relative to each firm's normal weeks; it is cited as the first evidence that earnings releases carry new information.

findings.statement: Method: announcement-week squared abnormal returns and volume ratios vs the firm's non-announcement weeks.
Evidence based on visual inspection and informal statistics; sample not random (Bamber et al. 2000).

why.pattern: Information arrival raises volume and volatility.
